explication: Animeko is a cross-platform anime discovery and viewing app. The main user journey is finding a title or episode, choosing a source, watching with danmaku, and syncing viewing progress; offline caching and watch-together are parallel capabilities. The tree and README establish these product stages, while sampled code confirms search, selector/RSS source processing, torrent caching, Android torrent service behavior, and watch-together sync guidance. UI-to-domain wiring and several unsampled integrations are therefore represented only where documented, not as inferred call chains.
